formats.migration: No rewriting of existing daemon/material/config formats; archive is explicit at proven teardown.
formats.fingerprint: Does not enter delta/history fingerprints; archive receipts bind workspace/tree/nonce/channel and log digest/size.

formats.trustBoundary: External user authority records real delivery and retains its blob references; mutable Git-admin cache hints cannot grant cleanup ownership.
formats.compatibility: Exact strict v1; missing or mismatching delivery witnesses force rebuilding rather than cache adoption.
formats.migration: No implicit rewriting; delivery explicitly publishes an immutable witness.
formats.fingerprint: Binds input delivery stamp, file/blob mapping and workspace/tree identity; does not change delta/history fingerprints.

formats.trustBoundary: User authority outside both checkouts binds exact finish proof and current copies to saved regular Git source blobs.
formats.compatibility: Strict v1/v2/v3 remain unchanged; explicit v4 admits archived declared build outputs. New kinds in old versions and future versions refuse.
formats.migration: No implicit migration or existing registry/checkout/config widening; finish explicitly captures a new immutable receipt.
formats.fingerprint: Does not enter delta/history fingerprints; binds the existing sealed finish proof and SHA-256 source/target digests.

formats.trustBoundary: Strict user-controlled pair registry and contained checkout receipts; metadata does not authorize foreign deletion.
formats.compatibility: Version 1 identity/name/path/branch/pin and generation validation; future records refuse.
formats.migration: Explicit creation/recovery only; no implicit config or existing checkout rewrite.
formats.fingerprint: Workspace UUID selects operational ref namespace; legacy unselected delta/history behavior remains unchanged.
